plan.planning_summary: Refining route_03 (28-layer HfO2/SiO2 alternating stack) based on prior iteration observations. Four iterations show target scores plateauing around 0.79-0.82 with numerical convergence issues. Feedback directives recommend targeted perturbation of thin layers (<70 nm) and temporary margin relaxation. Three complementary routes proposed: (1) 28-layer with thin-layer stochastic perturbation per feedback, (2) 20-layer reduced count to test robustness-performance tradeoff, (3) 24-layer with differential evolution optimizer to escape local minima. All routes preserve HfO2/SiO2 materials, fused silica substrate, and dual-band objectives (high-T 1000-1700 nm, high-R 300-450 nm).

routes.title: 28-Layer Stack with Thin-Layer Stochastic Perturbation
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Layers below 70 nm thickness are numerically sensitive and contribute to convergence ceilings; applying ±15% uniform random perturbation exclusively to these thin layers while relaxing tightest_margin by 0.02 will expand the valid candidate pool and enable escape from local optima observed in iterations 07, 11, and 14.
routes.design_principle: Targeted stochastic perturbation of thin layers disrupts numerical convergence without destabilizing the overall stack structure. Temporary margin relaxation increases valid candidate count for exploration before re-tightening.

routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2. Initialize thicknesses from iteration_14 best candidate (candidate HfO2_SiO2_28layer_opt__gradient_thickness__01). Apply ±15% uniform random perturbation exclusively to layers with thickness <70 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized. Maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band. Temporarily relax tightest_margin constraint by 0.02 to target valid_candidates >= 15. Total layer count fixed at 28. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: Changed from iteration_14 by applying feedback directive: targeted ±15% perturbation to thin layers (<70 nm) and temporary 0.02 margin relaxation. Prior iteration used Gaussian initialization without thin-layer-specific perturbation. This addresses numerical convergence issues observed in iterations 03, 11, and 14.

routes.title: 20-Layer Reduced Count Stack for Robustness Tradeoff
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Reducing layer count from 28 to 20 will improve robustness_score by reducing cumulative thickness tolerance sensitivity, while maintaining acceptable dual-band performance through optimized quarter-wave initialization at band center wavelengths (375 nm for UV stopband, 1350 nm for IR passband).
routes.design_principle: Fewer layers reduce fabrication complexity and cumulative tolerance effects. Quarter-wave initialization at band centers provides physical starting point for dual-band optimization. Evidence shows 20-layer stacks can achieve high reflectance with proper material pairing.
routes.proposed_topology: 20-layer alternating stack: HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2|HfO2|SiO2 on fused silica substrate, air incidence

This tests whether reduced complexity improves robustness while maintaining acceptable dual-band performance. Addresses observation that 28-layer designs show numerical convergence issues.

routes.title: 24-Layer Stack with Differential Evolution Optimizer
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Differential evolution optimizer will escape local minima that trapped gradient_thickness optimizer in iterations 07, 11, and 14, enabling discovery of non-quarter-wave thickness configurations that achieve higher dual-band performance with 24 layers as intermediate complexity between 20 and 28.
routes.design_principle: Global optimization via differential evolution explores thickness space more broadly than gradient-based methods. 24 layers provides intermediate complexity balancing performance and robustness. Evidence shows global optimization can explore 10^8 configurations for 4-layer designs.

routes.execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Run for 200 generations or until convergence. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
routes.revision_reason: New route changing optimizer from gradient_thickness (used in iterations 07, 11, 14) to differential_evolution_thickness. Layer count changed from 28 to 24 as intermediate between route_03_refine_02 (20 layers) and prior iterations (28 layers). Addresses observation that gradient optimizer plateaued around 0.79-0.82 target scores.
